techniques.name: Bayesian VAR
techniques.summary: Bayesian VAR with Minnesota/shrinkage priors for regularized multivariate forecasting.

parameters.name: lags
parameters.label: Lags
parameters.description: Number of VAR lags. Default 4. The Minnesota prior shrinks higher lags toward zero, so over-specifying is less costly here than in an unrestricted VAR.

parameters.name: lambda_shrinkage
parameters.label: Shrinkage
parameters.description: Overall prior tightness (λ1). Default 0.1. Smaller shrinks the system harder toward the random-walk prior; larger lets the data dominate. Monotone in the shrinkage direction.

parameters.name: lambda2
parameters.label: Cross-Equation Shrinkage
parameters.description: Minnesota cross-equation shrinkage (> 0; smaller = stronger shrinkage of other variables' lags). Blank uses the preset default.

parameters.name: lambda3
parameters.label: Lag-Decay
parameters.description: Minnesota lag-decay exponent (> 0; 1 = harmonic, 2 = quadratic). Blank uses the default (1.0).

parameters.name: include_constant
parameters.label: Include Constant
parameters.description: Include an intercept term in the VAR.

parameters.name: n_draws
parameters.label: Posterior Draws
parameters.description: Number of posterior draws for IRF/forecast credible bands (>= 1). Blank uses the preset default.

parameters.name: irf_horizon
parameters.label: IRF Horizon
parameters.description: Impulse-response / FEVD horizon (>= 1). Blank uses the preset default.

parameters.name: horizon
parameters.label: Forecast Horizon
parameters.description: Forecast horizon in periods. Default 12.

techniques.summary: Large Bayesian VAR with stochastic volatility for U.S. Treasury yield curve forecasting, conditioned on economist macro projections.

parameters.name: input_workbook
parameters.label: Input Workbook (.xlsx path)
parameters.description: Absolute path to a 3-sheet Bond Yield Forecast workbook (BondYield_Macro / BondYield_Yields / BondYield_Projections). Use the 'Open Input Template' Ribbon menu item to create one.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.label: Projection Scenario
parameters.description: Name of the projection scenario to run. Must match a column in BondYield_Projections.

parameters.name: horizon
parameters.label: Forecast Horizon (quarters)
parameters.description: Number of quarters to forecast. Range 1-20.

parameters.name: n_draws
parameters.label: MCMC Draws
parameters.description: Total MCMC draws (including burn-in). Range 1000-50000.

parameters.name: n_burn
parameters.label: MCMC Burn-in
parameters.description: Burn-in draws to discard. Range 100-20000. Must be < n_draws.

parameters.name: n_paths_per_draw
parameters.label: Forecast Paths per Draw
parameters.description: Conditional-forecast paths sampled per posterior draw. Range 10-500.

parameters.name: n_draws_subsample
parameters.label: Posterior Subsample for Forecasting
parameters.description: Number of kept posterior draws used to build the conditional-forecast distribution. Default 1,000; range 100-5000, capped to limit memory use on long horizons.

parameters.name: projection_uncertainty
parameters.label: Projection Uncertainty (std)
parameters.description: Standard deviation around the economist projections — how tightly the forecast is pinned to the chosen scenario. Default 0.25; smaller pins the paths more tightly to the projections, larger lets them deviate. Minimum 0.01.

parameters.name: lambda_1
parameters.label: Minnesota Lambda 1 (overall tightness)
parameters.description: Overall prior tightness (λ1). Default 0.2. Smaller shrinks the VAR coefficients harder toward the random-walk prior; larger lets the data speak. Range 0.001-2.0.

parameters.name: lambda_2
parameters.label: Minnesota Lambda 2 (cross-equation)
parameters.description: Cross-equation shrinkage (λ2). Default 0.5. Controls how strongly each equation's coefficients are pulled toward the others; smaller is tighter. Minimum 0.001.

parameters.name: lambda_3
parameters.label: Minnesota Lambda 3 (lag decay)
parameters.description: Lag-decay exponent (λ3). Default 1.0 (harmonic decay); higher values shrink more distant lags more aggressively. Minimum 0.001.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.label: Random Seed
parameters.description: Random seed for reproducibility.

techniques.name: Dynamic Factor Model
techniques.summary: Extract common latent factors from multiple time series using dynamic factor models.

parameters.name: n_factors
parameters.label: Number of Factors
parameters.description: Number of latent common factors to extract. Default 1; increase when several independent forces drive the panel.

parameters.name: factor_order
parameters.label: Factor AR Order
parameters.description: Autoregressive order of the factor dynamics. Default 2.

parameters.name: transform
parameters.label: Input Transform
parameters.description: How to prepare the input series. 'auto' runs an ADF test on each series and applies log-differencing (month-over-month % change) when any are non-stationary — the Stock-Watson canonical treatment. 'log_diff' forces log-differencing, 'diff' forces simple first-differencing, 'none' uses input as-is (appropriate only when inputs are already stationary growth rates or deviations).

techniques.name: Principal Component Analysis

parameters.name: n_components
parameters.label: Components
parameters.description: Number of components to retain. Blank keeps all available (the smaller of observations and series); set an integer to cap the count.

parameters.name: standardize
parameters.label: Standardize
parameters.description: Center and scale each series before decomposition. Default on, and recommended — the Kaiser eigenvalue rule is only meaningful on standardized data, and unscaled PCA lets the highest-variance series dominate.

parameters.name: rotation
parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.description: Optional component rotation for interpretability. Default none; varimax rotates the retained loadings toward a simpler structure.

techniques.name: Hierarchical Forecast Reconciliation
techniques.summary: Reconcile forecasts across a hierarchy (requires TSL_HIERARCHY mapping table).

parameters.name: method
parameters.label: Reconciliation Method
parameters.description: Reconciliation approach. MinT family (Wickramasuriya-Athanasopoulos-Hyndman 2019): ols, wls_variance (alias wls), mint_shrinkage (Schafer-Strimmer 2005, WAH recommended), mint_sample (full sample covariance, requires T > n_total). Classical: bottom_up, top_down. Default ols for backward compatibility; Tier 2 recommends mint_shrinkage upgrade when defaulted.

parameters.name: hierarchy_table
parameters.label: Hierarchy Table
parameters.description: Name of hierarchy mapping table

parameters.name: S_matrix
parameters.label: Summing Matrix S
parameters.description: Optional explicit n-level summing matrix as list-of-lists, shape (n_total, n_bottom). Presence activates explicit n-level mode (hts / fable / statsforecast API); absence uses auto 2-level construction from series order.

parameters.name: y_hat_matrix
parameters.label: Base Forecasts Matrix
parameters.description: Optional explicit base-forecast matrix as list-of-lists, shape (n_total, h). Only used in explicit n-level mode; overrides internal base_forecaster computation.

parameters.name: residuals_matrix
parameters.label: Residuals Matrix
parameters.description: Optional explicit in-sample residuals matrix as list-of-lists, shape (n_total, T_train). Only used in explicit n-level mode; overrides internal base_forecaster residuals.

parameters.name: nonnegative
parameters.label: Nonnegative Reconciliation
parameters.description: Apply NNLS projection to bottom-level forecasts so all reconciled values are non-negative. Useful for count / positive-only data. Forfeits the MinT minimum-trace optimality when the constraint binds.

parameters.name: dist

parameters.name: q

parameters.description: GARCH order: number of past log-variance terms. Default 1.

parameters.name: dist
parameters.label: Distribution
parameters.description: Innovation distribution. Default Student-t; options normal, t, skewt.

parameters.name: o
parameters.label: Asymmetry Order
parameters.description: Leverage (asymmetry) order in the log-variance equation. Default 1. In EGARCH a negative leverage coefficient means negative shocks raise volatility more.

parameters.name: horizon

parameters.description: Estimation method. Default quasi_ml (fast but biased — fits log squared returns); mcmc samples the return likelihood directly for an unbiased fit. quasi_ml for a quick look, mcmc for publication-grade estimates.

parameters.name: detrending_bandwidth
parameters.label: Detrending Bandwidth
parameters.description: Gaussian kernel sigma in samples. Default T/10 per Dakos convention. Ignored unless detrending_method='gaussian'.

parameters.name: rolling_window
parameters.label: Rolling Window
parameters.description: Rolling-window size for indicator computation. Default per preset (50% of series length).

parameters.name: kendall_lookback
parameters.label: Kendall Lookback
parameters.description: Trailing-window size for Kendall tau. Default per preset (Fast=30%, Balanced/Thorough=50% of indicator-series length).

parameters.name: compute_pvalues
parameters.label: Compute P-Values
parameters.description: When True (default), computes empirical p-values for Kendall tau via AR(1)-bootstrap surrogates. Adds significant runtime: 200-5000 surrogates per preset. Set False for fast asymptotic p-values.

parameters.name: n_surrogates
parameters.label: Surrogate Count
parameters.description: Surrogate count for empirical p-values. Default per preset (Fast=200, Balanced=1000, Thorough=5000). Higher counts yield tighter p-value precision at proportional runtime cost.

parameters.name: composite_method
parameters.label: Composite Method
parameters.description: Method for combining per-indicator Kendall taus into composite EWS score. equal_weight_zscore averages z-scored taus. fisher_combined uses Fisher's method on p-values; requires compute_pvalues=True.

parameters.name: expose_rolling_series
parameters.label: Expose Rolling Series
parameters.description: When True, populates the six rolling-indicator time series in audit_fields for plotting. Set False to reduce payload size on long input series.
